title: Reviewed procurement entry guide
summary: Reviewed practical guidance on the route and evidence to check before entering public procurement.
bodyMarkdown:
## What to confirm first

Confirm the procurement route before preparing evidence.

- Define the application objective and target items.
- Review the applicable confirmation and certification requirements.

[Read the official guidance](https://example.test/procurement)
